# /mandao-constitution

<!-- mandao:generated by npm run diagrams from core/commands/constitution.md; do not edit below -->

Establish or update the project foundation (technical constitution and product context), the AGENTS.md hierarchy and the project skills.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../diagrams/command-constitution-dark.svg">
  <img alt="/mandao-constitution: steps, approval and what it writes" src="../diagrams/command-constitution-light.svg">
</picture>

## Usage

```
/mandao-constitution [auto|new|legacy|active] [--product]
```

| Argument | Required / default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `<auto\|new\|legacy\|active>` | default `auto` | How to start: new (no code yet), legacy (code, no constitution), active (update an existing one) |
| `--product` | optional | Also distill business sources from .mandao/sources.yml (or `ingest <source>`) |

## Examples

- `/mandao-constitution` — detects the mode and builds or updates the constitution
- `/mandao-constitution active` — proposes changes to an existing constitution, one diff per file
- `/mandao-constitution --product` — adds the product context from your tracker and documents

## Reads

- `.mandao/config.yml`
- `.mandao/sources.yml`
- `docs/constitution/`

## Writes

- `docs/constitution/*.md`: workspace constitution and product context
- `<project>/docs/constitution/*.md`: project level
- `AGENTS.md`: root

## Steps

1. Read the workspace
2. Map the code
3. Technical constitution
4. Product context
5. AGENTS.md hierarchy
6. Skills
7. Clarify and approve (you approve)

## Approval

Yes: it stops for your approval.

## Scripts (no tokens)

- `mandao run fingerprint`
- `mandao run branching`
- `mandao run security-scanning`
- `mandao run stack-check`

Paths are the defaults; `paths` in `.mandao/config.yml` can change them.
